body.message:
Good afternoon! Please specify any questions. I own an apartment in Prive and am considering engaging a professional property management company. Before I proceed, I would like to request the following information from you:

1. Your cooperation terms:
   · Management fee structure (percentage of rent, fixed fee, or hybrid)
   · Any setup, marketing, or administrative fees
   · Contract duration and termination conditions
1. Rental price forecast for my unit:
   · Current market rental value (long‑term and short‑term)
   · Expected price trend for the next 6–12 months
   · Any data or market report you can share to support your forecast
